title: Godinger Windsor Jam Jar
text: Godinger Windsor Jam Jar. This jam jar and spoon set is really cute and useful.  Just to note... it is very small... holds about 1/3 cup of jam at the most.  It thick glass... I think it would be ok in the dishwasher, however, hand washed it.  The spoon is pretty good weight... and squared at the bottom, as jam spoons are.  The lid has a groove in it for the spoon to stick out of. It stands about 4" tall from top to bottom ( just eyeballing it)  It arrived quickly (I have prime) and in excellent condition.
